request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: This test clicks row 0's checkbox (Movie 1) and then re-queries checkbox() by index. Under the required unwatched-first ordering, the movie just toggled to watched moves to the end of the list, so the index-0 checkbox now belongs to the still-unwatched Movie 2 and the original assertion (checkbox() is checked) would fail. Changed the assertion to checkbox(1), which is the checkbox of the movie that was clicked (it now renders last). The test's intent — clicking a checkbox toggles watched, updates watchedCount and the subtitle — is unchanged.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same cause: the test clicks blank space on row 0 (Movie 1), making it watched, which the new ordering moves to the end of the list; the index-based checkbox() lookup then resolves to Movie 2's unchecked checkbox. Changed the assertion to checkbox(1) so it still verifies that the clicked movie's checkbox is checked. The test's intent — clicking blank row space toggles watched — is unchanged.
